title: Basic Bees: Swarm Destroyer!
description: Princess Toad’s un-Bee-lievable Adventure, reclaiming her precious stool!

This video game prototype was my first foray into the wonderful world of Unity and C#. I plan to expand and polish Princess Toad’s escapades soon. But for now, take her for a spin and show those Basic Bees who’s boss!

title: Lairbound Legends
description: A first-year student project with a team of four people, using a database of airports. We ended up making the game about flying a dragon between different lairs!
The backend uses Python and SQL, and frontend was developed with JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
We had a team of creative powerhouses, and ended up arranging original music, and creating a flying and a turn-based RPG-style minigames!
